definitions.explanation: A state's right under international law to use armed force to defend itself against an armed attack. In Japan the word is tied to the debate over what Article 9 of the Constitution allows.

examples.japanese: {自衛権|じえいけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行使|こうし}→行使：14087_koushi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To exercise the right of self-defense.
Every country has the right of self-defense.

examples.japanese: {集団的自衛権|しゅうだんてきじえいけん}をめぐって、⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Heated debate over collective self-defense continued in the Diet.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自衛権|じえいけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行使|こうし}→行使：14087_koushi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to exercise the right of self-defense
- {個別的自衛権|こべつてきじえいけん}: the right of individual self-defense (defending one's own country)
- {集団的自衛権|しゅうだんてきじえいけん}: the right of collective self-defense (defending an ally that is attacked)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Whether Japan may exercise collective self-defense was long answered "no" by the government; a 2014 cabinet decision and the 2015 security laws allowed it in limited cases, and the change remains politically contested.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{自衛|じえい}→自衛：00121_jiei⟧: self-defense
- ⟦{自衛隊|じえいたい}→自衛隊：05790_jieitai⟧: the Self-Defense Forces
